operation.title: Operation
operation.description: What to do: indicator (get values), verify (check a claimed figure), snapshot (country overview), inflation (adjust across years), fx (convert currencies), series (raw series id), search, registry (list indicators).

indicator.title: Indicator key
indicator.description: e.g. inflation_cpi, gdp_growth, unemployment_rate, govt_debt_gdp (run operation=registry for the full list).

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO3/ISO2 code or English name, e.g. USA, Barbados, Japan.

claimed_value.title: Claimed value (verify)
claimed_value.description: The figure to check, in the series' own units.

as_of.title: As of (verify)
as_of.description: Optional: historical IMF-vintage verification — judge against the dated IMF WEO edition resolved from this date (e.g. 2019-04) instead of today's data (conservative month-calendar resolution; WEO archive only — the result discloses both). Only for gdp_growth, current_account_gdp, govt_debt_gdp, fiscal_balance_gdp, govt_revenue_gdp, govt_expenditure_gdp.

start_year.title: Start year
start_year.description: Optional: only return observations from this year onward.

end_year.title: End year
end_year.description: Optional: only return observations up to this year.

latest_only.title: Latest value only
latest_only.description: Return just the most recent published observation.

from_year.title: From year (inflation)
from_year.description: The year the amount is denominated in, e.g. 1995.

to_year.title: To year (inflation)
to_year.description: The year to convert the amount into, e.g. 2025.

query.title: Query (search)
query.description: Free-text search over indicators and DBnomics datasets.

items.title: Batch items
items.description: Optional: array of parameter objects to run in one call (each may set its own operation). One pay-per-event charge per successful item.
